title: What happens when you cut a suspension bridge cable thick enough to hold an aircraft carrier?
angle: Explores the extreme engineering feats, hidden redundancy systems, and terrifying physics required to keep mega-bridges from tearing themselves apart under impossible loads.
description: An immersive, scientifically accurate 8-10 minute deep dive into the extreme physics, hidden redundancies, and terrifying engineering realities that keep mega-suspension bridges from tearing themselves apart under impossible loads.
